current_prompt.body:
READ the set S and target T=40
FOR each subset of S generated by backtracking
IF the subset sum equals T
THEN EMIT the subset and VERIFY its sum
ENDIF
REPEAT until the full search tree is explored
COUNT the total number of emitted subsets
REPORT the total count of solutions

current_plan.body:
READ the set S and target T
GENERATE subsets of S using backtracking
IF a subset sum equals T THEN EMIT the subset and VERIFY its sum
CONTINUE until the entire search tree is explored
COUNT the emitted subsets
REPORT the total count of solutions
